source: CollegeFootballData.com recruiting classes, team class rankings and head coaches; distributions only

generation.note: state_share: a state's share of each star band's prospects (10 classes); towns: [name, prospects, lat, lon]

dynamics.model: class_dev[Y] = c + a*class_dev[Y-1] + b*(win%[Y-1] - team win% norm) + new_coach_first + new_coach_second + power4
dynamics.class_dev: z-score of class points among FBS that year, minus the team's 2005-2026 mean

coaches.edge: mean class z-score above the school's baseline across a coach's classes there (3+ classes)
